literal: For what are they fit, the base? One (trouble) when befalls, for selling are they fit, having hastened.
translation: What are the base actually good for? When trouble strikes, they are only fit to quickly sell themselves.
modern: கயவர்கள் எதற்குத்தான் பயன்படுவார்கள்? ஒரு சிறு துன்பம் வந்தாலும், தங்களை விரைவாக விற்றுக்கொள்ளவே அவர்கள் பயன்படுவார்கள்.
explanation: The couplet asks a rhetorical question: what purpose do base people serve? The word 'எற்றிற்கு' (for what) sets up this inquiry into their usefulness. The answer is that when 'ஒன்று' (one thing, implying a hardship or crisis) happens to them, they will immediately sell themselves out. 'விற்றற்கு' (for selling) means they will compromise their dignity, betray others, or literally sell themselves into servitude to escape trouble. Thus, their only predictable utility is their swift readiness to abandon their principles when pressured.
